info.title: soldi
info.description: Personal-finance thermometer API. Authenticate with the `__Host-soldi_session` cookie (`soldi_session` over plain HTTP). Money is a decimal string. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

401.description: `invalid-credentials`, the same for an unknown email and a wrong password

201.description: Signed up and signed in; sets the session cookie. Settings and default categories are created

200.description: Unarchived recurring bills by due day, then name

422.description: Name not 1 to 100 characters, amount not above zero or with more than two places, due day not 1 to 31, or `category_id` not one of the caller's active bill categories

204.description: Archived: out of every list and month; its payments stay

404.description: Missing, already archived or another user's

200.description: The bill after the change; absent fields stay as they are

422.description: Same rules as create, on the bill after the change

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month being paid, `YYYY-MM`; `date` must fall in it

404.description: Missing, paused, archived or another user's

409.description: Already paid in the date's month (`bill-already-paid`)

422.description: `date` outside `month`, `month` not `YYYY-MM`, amount not above zero or with more than two places, or a date before the opening date (`before-opening-date`)

204.description: The month's payment entry is deleted

404.description: Not paid that month, or another user's bill

200.description: Active categories: income, bills, then daily; by name within a kind

409.description: An active category of the same kind has this name

204.description: Archived: it leaves the list, its entries keep it

200.description: The category after the change; absent fields stay as they are
Every calendar day with its balance and tier, carried from the opening balance

422.description: `month` is not `YYYY-MM` (`validation`), or is before the opening date's month (`month-before-opening`)

200.description: Opening balance saved, bills created, `onboarded` is true

422.description: Fields named like `bills[0].amount`; nothing is saved

200.description: The month's outflow and income by category, each against the previous month
Twelve months of income and savings with the year totals and the goal
The month's savings, created or replaced

422.description: Amount below zero or with more than two places, `year` outside 2000..2100, `month` outside 1..12, or a month before the opening date's month (`month-before-opening`)

200.description: The settings after the change; absent fields stay as they are

422.description: Money with more than two places, tiers out of order (names the upper tier of the first pair), goal outside 1..100

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only this category's entries; another user's category lists nothing

200.description: The month's entries: newest date first, then newest entry first

400.description: No `month`, or `category_id` is not a UUID

404.description: The category is missing, archived or another user's

422.description: Amount not above zero or with more than two places, note over 500 characters, a kind other than the category's (`category_id`), or a date before the opening date (`before-opening-date`)

200.description: The entry after the change; absent fields stay as they are

404.description: The entry is missing or another user's, or the new category is missing, archived or another user's

422.description: Same rules as create, on the entry after the change, `before-opening-date` included

Bill.description: A recurring bill. `due_day` 29 to 31 falls on the last day of a shorter month.

BillOfMonth.description:
An active recurring bill in the month. `amount` is what was paid, or the bill's amount while
unpaid; `due_date` clamps a late due day to the month's last day; `overdue` is unpaid with
`due_date` before today in São Paulo.

Category.description: `icon` is a lucide icon name; `color` a palette token, `cat-1` to `cat-12`.

CategoryReport.description: `outflow` (bills and daily) and `income`, each by amount, largest first.

amount.description: Greater than zero, up to two decimal places.

category_id.description: One of the caller's active `bill` categories.

CreateCategory.description: `icon` defaults to `circle-dashed`; `color` to the next token for the kind.

amount.description: Greater than zero, up to two decimal places; never rounded.

category_id.description: One of the caller's active categories.

note.description: Up to 500 characters; blank means none.

Day.description: One calendar day: what came in and went out, and the balance at its end.

MonthSavings.description: The month's savings (SOL-5); `pct` is `amount / income`, null when income is 0.

MonthView.description:
`month` is `YYYY-MM`. `balance_today` is the balance at today, or at the month's last day
when the month is past. `projected_balance` is the balance at the month's end minus the
unpaid `bills_of_month`.

opening_balance.description: What the user has today; may be negative.

PayBill.description: `amount` defaults to the bill's amount; the bill itself never changes.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, the body of every error response.

SavingsMonth.description:
One month of the year. `income` and `saved` are null before the opening month; `pct` is
`saved / income` as a percentage with one decimal, null when income is 0.

SavingsYear.description:
`pct` is `total_saved / total_income`; `goal_progress_pct` is `pct / goal_pct`, capped at
100, null without a goal or without income.

amount.description: Zero or more, up to two decimal places.

Settings.description:
Money is a decimal string with up to two places (`"-500.00"`). The tiers are the lower
bounds of the thermometer colors and are strictly increasing:
`tier_red < tier_zero < tier_yellow < tier_green`.

name.description: Defaults to the part of the e-mail before `@`.

Tier.description: The thermometer color of a balance; each lower bound is inclusive.

Totals.description: `outflow` is bills plus daily; `performance` is income minus outflow.

Transaction.description: `category` is the entry's category as it is now, archived or not.

recurring_bill_id.description: The recurring bill this entry pays, if any.

UpdateBill.description: Absent fields stay as they are. `active: false` keeps the bill out of the month.

UpdateCategory.description: Absent fields stay as they are; the kind never changes.

UpdateSettings.description: Absent fields stay as they are; `"savings_goal_pct": null` clears the goal.

UpdateTransaction.description: Absent fields stay as they are; `"note": null` clears the note.

onboarded.description: False until `POST /api/onboarding` runs; the web shows onboarding while it is false.
